faqs.q: What is the price of Roasted Cashew Nuts (रोस्टेड काजु) in Nepal?
faqs.a: NaturesMud Roasted Cashew Nuts (150 GM Glass Jar) costs Rs. 750 in Nepal (Rs. 500 per 100g). We deliver within 24–48 hours in Kathmandu Valley and across Nepal.

faqs.q: Why is the Roasted Cashew jar 150 GM while Raw Cashews are 200 GM at Rs. 750?
faqs.a: Slow dry-roasting removes natural kernel moisture and requires small-batch artisanal roasting and hand-grading of whole unbroken kernels, yielding 150 GM of ready-to-eat roasted cashews.

faqs.q: Are these cashews fried in oil or butter?
faqs.a: No! They are 100% dry-roasted without any oil, butter, or ghee—so they are never greasy.

faqs.q: What kind of salt is used on these cashews?
faqs.a: We use only a light dusting of pure unrefined Himalayan Pink Salt (Sindhe Noon).

faqs.q: Should I choose Raw or Roasted Cashews for baby food?
faqs.a: For babies (6M+), choose our Raw Whole Cashew Nuts (200 GM) since they have 0% added salt. Choose Roasted Cashew Nuts (150 GM) for adult and family snacking.
